_comment: Single source of the real robot's sensor layout. Units m, rad, kg. Frames are in Go2 base.

xt16.source: pose: Unitree-Go2-EDU-Plus TF; height/diameter/mass: Hesai PandarXT-16 manual (side connector); optical centre 46.4 mm: ori-drs/hesai_description XT32 (same housing size) -- confirm on XT16

mount.source: height DERIVED (XT16 bottom minus trunk top); footprint and mass ASSUMED

d435i.source: pose: Unitree-Go2-EDU-Plus TF (x estimated there); box/offset/mass: realsense-ros _d435.urdf.xacro@45fd6446

measured_2026_11_25.top_point: handle bar over the XT16 (higher than the XT16 top)
measured_2026_11_25.source: tape measure by the team, robot on flat floor; lying = belly-down damping pose

derived.note: trunk top = base + 0.057 (URDF). Lying base = mean(0.20,0.17) - 0.057 ~= 0.128. Handle 0.30 m lying, over the XT16 near the front: 0.30 - (0.20 - 0.057) ~= 0.157-0.17 above base; taken as 0.17 (XT16 top in the model is 0.163, handle sits ~1 cm higher).
